arStrings.szText: "The city fell some time ago. I did all I could to stop it."
I suppose that is all each of us can do, in the end. Each moment we are given...another chance to give.
I am not sure by what means I have returned, but I did not come alone. There are three of them—wandering the East, tormented by the Prime Evils who seized their souls.
Prince Aidan who became the vessel of Diablo. Sankekur who submitted to Mephisto. And the great Tal Rasha who gave his life to contain Baal, the Lord of Destruction.
Where the former two have gone, I do not know, but Tal Rasha... I lost sight of him on the road to the Fractured Peaks...a trail of ruin in his wake.
